* Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered reprint [[Wyron Serper (Revised)]] (October 1998). The card picture below it is that Revised card, whose game text is word for word this errata (read by eye beside the Glossary entry), recoloured to a black border by swccg.com in 2026: the drop shadow is cropped off, the white border is black and the corners are grey; nothing else is changed. File: [[:File:Hoth-L-wyronserper-Decipher-Errata-1998-black.png]]. The Players Committee's current image is its 2018 E card ([[Wyron Serper (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]); it has no D-E card yet.

Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered Revised card, [[Wyron Serper (Revised)]] (October 1998).
